title: Article 123 Article 123  If the counterparty to a voidable act is identified, the voidance or ratification of that act is made by the manifestation of intention to the counterparty.
statute_text:
Article 123 Article 123  If the counterparty to a voidable act is identified, the voidance or ratification of that act is made by the manifestation of intention to the counterparty.
(Requirements for Ratification)
